name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Mailchimp is an email marketing platform that offers a REST API for managing audiences, campaigns, and automation.
auth_notes: Mailchimp supports OAuth 2 for accessing data on behalf of other users.
access_notes: Users can create a Mailchimp account to obtain API credentials without a paid plan.

extras.rate_limits: The Marketing API has a limit of 10 simultaneous connections.

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2 authentication provides developers with a secure way to access Mailchimp Marketing API data on behalf of other Mailchimp users.
The Marketing API generally follows REST conventions, with some deviations.
After successfully registering your application, you’ll see the`client_id` and`client_secret` at the bottom of the page, which you’ll need to implement the OAuth 2 workflow on your server.

The most complete [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server for the [Mailchimp Marketing API](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/): **227 tools** to query and manage your Mailchimp account from any MCP-compatible client.
